settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Devices and sound preferences. Saved on this device.

profile.displayNameHint: The name other people see in voice rooms.
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB.
profile.avatarInvalidType: That file is not an image.
profile.bannerHint: The background color of your profile card.
profile.profileUrlHint: When set, your name becomes a clickable link. Leave empty to remove.
profile.bioPlaceholder: Tell others a bit about yourself...
profile.bioHint: Shown on your profile card. Up to 280 characters.

security.emailChangeHint: We'll send a confirmation link to your current email to approve the change.
security.emailChangeRequested: Check your current email to approve the change
security.emailNotVerifiedDescription: Confirm {email} to secure your account and unlock all features.
security.emailVerificationSentHint: Check your inbox and spam folder.

devices.errorDenied: No access to "{device}". Allow access in your browser settings.
devices.errorNotFound: Device "{device}" not found. Check that it is connected.
devices.errorBusy: Device "{device}" is in use by another application.

audio.activationPttNoBinding: Assign a key in the <link>Hotkeys tab</link> to use this mode.
audio.autoSensitivityHint: Adapts the threshold to your background noise. Turn off to set it manually.
audio.sensitivityHint: Drag the handle: audio is sent when the bar passes it. Green means you are being heard.
audio.microphoneHint: The microphone used to capture your voice.
audio.speakersHint: Where room audio is played back.
audio.testMicHint: Speak to see the level; press to hear yourself.
audio.autoGainControlHint: Evens out your microphone loudness. Turn off for music.
audio.voiceIsolationHint: Experimental — stronger voice isolation. Browser support varies.

video.cameraHint: The camera used when you turn on video.
video.cameraQualityHint: Resolution of your camera video. Higher quality uses more network and CPU.
video.screenQualityHint: Resolution and frame rate when sharing your screen. 30 fps suits fast-moving content.
video.mirrorHint: Flips your own preview. Other participants always see you unmirrored.

sounds.volumeHint: Loudness of all room sound effects.
sounds.reconnectHint: When your connection drops and recovers.
sounds.messageHint: A new message while the chat is closed.
sounds.reactionHint: When someone sends an emoji reaction.
sounds.ambienceHint: A calm loop that fades in when you are the only one left in a room.

system.closeToTrayHint: Close button hides the app to the system tray. Turn off to quit on close. The tray's Quit menu always exits.
system.invisibleModeHint: Join any room hidden: no password, and nobody sees or hears you.
system.shareActivityHint: People in the room see the name of the game you are playing. Desktop app only.

shortcuts.webNotice: Custom hotkeys are not supported in the browser yet. To use custom hotkeys, <link>download</link> the desktop app.

errors.needsModifier: Use a combination with Ctrl, Shift or Alt
errors.systemTaken: This combination is reserved by another application

deleteAccount.description: Your account is deleted for good, along with your profile, rooms and friend list. We will email you a confirmation link.
deleteAccount.hint: Follow the link in the email to confirm.
deleteAccount.consequences: Your profile, rooms, friends and notification devices are removed. Your messages stay, without your name on them.

update.title: Update available
update.checkTimedOut: Update check timed out. Try again later.
update.mobileBody: Download the new version of the app

downloadApp.title: Download Chatovo
downloadApp.description: Native app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.

feedback.title: Report a problem
feedback.description: Tell us what broke. A screenshot helps us find it much faster.
feedback.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened and what you were doing…
feedback.sent: Thanks! Your report has been sent.
feedback.hint: Include what you were doing right before it happened — that is usually the missing piece.

konami.title: The Da Vinci Code
konami.description: You still remember the Konami code. Respect.

nightOwl.title: Night owl
nightOwl.description: Joining a voice chat past 3 AM is a diagnosis.

quietOne.title: The quiet one
quietOne.description: An hour in the room, not a sound. We heard everything. Or rather — nothing.

soloConcert.title: Solo concert
soloConcert.description: Half an hour alone in a room. Great acoustics, modest crowd.

muteMaster.title: Mute master
muteMaster.description: 25 mic toggles. Make up your mind already.

snake.title: Found the snake
snake.description: Who clicks a logo seven times, anyway?

ambience.started: Quiet in here — starting the music
